note_on_tester_scope: The tester agent wrote only test code (correct — no production files touched). However AttemptServicePhase2Test.java as originally written referenced repository/service methods that do not exist on the real interfaces (findByPublicIdAndStudentPublicId, findByPublicIdAndPinnedSnapshot, timerService.getTaskTimerState, answerSubmitService.submitAnswer(5 args)) — these were hallucinated, not the real AttemptService/ExamAttemptRepository/PinnedItemRepository/TimerService/AnswerSubmitService APIs. ck:cook rewrote this one file to use the actual APIs (findWithPinnedByPublicIdAndStudentPublicId, findByPinnedSnapshotIdAndOrderIndex, timerService.getState, answerSubmitService.submit(3 args)) verified against the real Phase-1-era AttemptService.java source, so RED now fails only for the correct reason (missing Phase 2 symbols), not for referencing nonexistent methods. SubmissionDecryptionServiceTest.java was left as written by the tester — verified correct against real javax.crypto APIs. Correction also noted: GlobalExceptionHandler does NOT need explicit registration per exception type — it already handles the DomainException base class generically via @ExceptionHandler(DomainException.class); the 'next_steps_for_green' item about registering the two new exceptions there is unnecessary, they're handled automatically by extending DomainException.

implementation_notes: Base64-decode wrappedKey, iv, ciphertext; catch IllegalArgumentException and rethrow as SubmissionDecryptionException immediately
Validate decoded iv.length == 12 (96 bits); reject immediately if not
Unwrap AES key via Cipher.getInstance('RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-256AndMGF1Padding') with explicit OAEPParameterSpec(SHA-256, MGF1, MGF1ParameterSpec.SHA256, PSource.PSpecified.DEFAULT)
Decrypt via Cipher.getInstance('AES/GCM/NoPadding') with GCMParameterSpec(128, iv)

Catch InvalidKeyException, BadPaddingException, IllegalBlockSizeException (unwrap failures), AEADBadTagException (GCM auth failure), NullPointerException — all rethrow as SubmissionDecryptionException
No exception path may escape unmapped (500) — all failures must be caught and wrapped

critical_test_notes: SubmissionDecryptionServiceTest uses REAL RSA keypair (same as Phase 1, generated via openssl genpkey) — not fabricated or hand-typed Base64
Round-trip test encrypts in-test using java.crypto with the same algorithms (RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-256AndMGF1Padding, AES/GCM/NoPadding) the service is expected to use
IV length validation test uses 16-byte IV to trigger rejection before GCM attempt — verifies fail-fast behavior
Malformed Base64 tests use intentionally invalid strings ('not-valid-base64!!!!' and empty '') to trigger IllegalArgumentException during decode
AttemptServicePhase2Test mocks SubmissionDecryptionService.decrypt to return known plaintext — avoids testing crypto twice; the real crypto is unit-tested in SubmissionDecryptionServiceTest
Both test classes follow AttemptServiceTest Phase 1 style: Mockito mocks, helper methods (createAttempt, createPinnedItem, createTimerState), @DisplayName annotations
